title: Report review
passage: Have you had a chance to review the survey results? A. They surveyed two hundred shoppers. B. The view from here is excellent. C. Only the first section, I am afraid.
passageZh:
你有時間審閱調查結果了嗎？
A. 他們訪問了兩百名購物者。
B. 這裡的景色很好。
C. 恐怕只看了第一部分。
